title: Angry Man Trespasses After Being Banned From Store And Immediately Regrets It
description:
#news #police #bodycam

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:

On 05/18/2022 at approximately 7:44 P.M, police were dispatched to a trespass complaint at Kwik Trip located at 506 Cass Street. Dispatch advised they received a call from an employee stating Jordan Hughes was in the Store and was getting violent. Jordan had kicked the door on his way out. Jordan was last seen walking towards Cameron Park wearing a white shirt with a black vest and jeans. Dispatch advised Jordan was “punching air as he walked”.  After the investigation, Jordan Hughes was taken into custody for Resisting an Officer, Bail Jumping, and a Probation Hold. Jordan was also cited for Trespassing.
